class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="computer-use">电脑控制<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">电脑控制（Computer Use）让 ZCode Agent 在你授权后看到屏幕、操作本机的桌面应用，比如在计算器里算数、在备忘录里记东西、在系统工具里完成设置。网页里的操作请使用 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/browser-use">浏览器自动化</a>。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">支持范围</strong>：本机 macOS（12 及以上）与 Windows。暂不支持 Linux 桌面和 SSH / WSL / Docker 等远程工作区。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="enable">开启电脑控制<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">电脑控制默认关闭，开启只需两步：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 电脑控制</strong>，打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">启用电脑控制</strong>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">（可选）打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">在输入框显示电脑操作按钮</strong>，输入框工具栏会出现 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">电脑操作</strong> 按钮，可以随时查看状态、进入设置。</li>
</ol>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain" style="--figure-max:min(720px, 100%)"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-computer-use/settings-cn.webp" alt="设置 → 电脑控制：启用电脑控制、在输入框显示电脑操作按钮，以及辅助功能与屏幕录制均显示已授权" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">开启后，输入框工具栏会出现 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">电脑操作</strong> 按钮：</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain" style="--figure-max:min(640px, 100%)"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261123-computer-use/composer-cn.webp" alt="输入框工具栏中，执行模式右侧出现电脑操作按钮" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在 macOS 上，开启后还要完成下面的系统授权才能使用；Windows 开启即可使用。关闭电脑控制后，已经打开的对话要重启 ZCode 才会生效。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="status">电脑操作按钮的状态<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">把鼠标移到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">电脑操作</strong> 按钮上，可以看到当前状态：</p>
<div class="docs-table mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">状态</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">含义与处理</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">空闲</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">首次使用时自动启动，不需要手动操作</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">正在启用</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">正在启用电脑操作插件，稍等片刻</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已就绪</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">直接在对话里描述要做的事</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">缺少 macOS 权限</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">点击按钮，按提示完成 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#macos-permissions">系统授权</a></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">启用失败</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">重启 ZCode 后重试，或让 ZCode 排查日志</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">会话进行中</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">当前对话的任务还在运行，暂时不能切换电脑操作；任务结束后再试</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="authorize">授权<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">电脑控制有两层授权：一次性的系统权限，以及每次操作前的确认。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="macos-permissions">macOS 系统权限<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 需要两项系统权限，设置页会分别显示 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已授权</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">未授权</strong>：</p>
<div class="docs-table mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">权限</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">用来做什么</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">辅助功能</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">读取和操作应用界面，模拟键盘、鼠标输入</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">屏幕录制</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">截取屏幕画面，让 ZCode Agent 看到应用当前的样子</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">授权方法：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 电脑控制</strong> 点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">打开辅助功能设置</strong>，系统设置会跳到对应页面。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在列表中打开 ZCode 的开关；列表里没有 ZCode 时，按提示把 ZCode 图标拖进列表。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">回到 ZCode，用同样的方法完成 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">屏幕录制</strong>。</li>
</ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">两项都显示 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已授权</strong> 就可以使用了。授权后可能会先显示 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已授权，正在验证</strong>：系统权限已经授予，ZCode 正在验证能否实际控制界面和截图，稍等即可。如果显示 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">授权状态需要重新确认</strong>，或者授权后状态一直没有更新，点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重启 Helper</strong>；仍不生效再点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重启 ZCode</strong>。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="approve">操作确认<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode Agent 每次要操作电脑前，会先在对话中请你确认：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">允许</strong>：只允许这一次。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">始终允许本项目中的电脑控制</strong>：在当前项目里不再询问。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">拒绝</strong>：不执行这次操作。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">是否弹出确认取决于当前的权限模式，详见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/safety-confirm">安全操作确认</a>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="example">使用示例<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">开启并授权后，直接在对话里描述要做的事：</p>
<div class="docs-wrap-code"><pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">用电脑控制打开计算器，算出 1280 × 0.85 + 66，再把算式和结果记到一条新的备忘录里。
</code></pre></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">也可以在输入框中 @ <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">电脑控制</strong> 明确指定。ZCode Agent 会依次打开计算器、按键计算、切到备忘录写下结果。</p>

<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">操作过程中：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">macOS</strong>：屏幕上会出现画中画窗口，实时显示 ZCode Agent 正在操作的应用，操作光标标出它点击的位置。ZCode Agent 可以在后台操作，不抢你的鼠标和键盘焦点。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Windows</strong>：屏幕顶部显示“ZCode 正在操作电脑”提示。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">对话里</strong>：每一步归入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">电脑控制</strong> 卡片，附带截图，点击可以放大；展开某一步，可以看到操作信息、执行结果和返回的界面状态。需要中途停止时，点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">停止控制电脑</strong>。</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="actions">能做哪些操作<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h3>
<div class="docs-table mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">类别</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">操作</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">查看</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">列出运行中的应用和窗口、读取应用界面、截取全屏、放大屏幕区域</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">鼠标</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">单击、双击、右键、拖动、滚动</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">键盘与输入</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">输入文本、填写内容、选择文本、按键、长按按键</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">其他</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">打开应用或文件夹、读取和写入剪贴板、等待界面响应</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode Agent 会优先读取应用界面、按界面元素操作；界面变化后原来的元素失效，它会重新读取再继续。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="safety">安全提示<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">截图会作为工具结果发送给所选模型的服务商。使用前请关闭或移开含有隐私、敏感信息的窗口。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">电脑控制拥有较高的桌面权限，只在可信的任务中使用，并留意 ZCode Agent 正在操作的应用。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">电脑控制可以读取和写入剪贴板。使用时不要在剪贴板里留着密码、验证码等敏感内容。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">同一时间只有一个会话可以控制电脑，其他会话需要等待。</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="limits">使用限制<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">屏幕锁定时无法操作。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">macOS 上无法把应用切到最前，需要应用位于前台才能完成的操作可能失败。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">Windows 上启动部分应用或截图时，可能会把窗口切到前台。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
